def fn(x):
    # QWERTY keyboard order used as the cipher alphabet
    plain  = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

    # Build translation tables for lower‑ and upper‑case letters

        plain + plain.upper(),
        cipher + cipher.upper()
    )
    return x.translate(trans)
